description: Declarative cross-schedule relational completeness rules derived from Official Bankruptcy Forms B 101, B 106A/B-J, B 107 (SOFA), B 108, and B 122A/C.

rules.prompt_template: Asset '{description}' (${value}) on Schedule A/B has no linked loan on Schedule D and is not confirmed free-and-clear. Is there an active loan/lease or is it owned free and clear?
Secured claim '{creditor_name}' (${amount}) on Schedule D lacks a linked collateral asset and verified market value on Schedule A/B. Supply collateral description and value.
Chapter 7 secured claim '{creditor_name}' requires a Form 108 Statement of Intention (surrender, retain_and_redeem, or retain_and_reaffirm).
Paystubs from '{employer}' show retirement/401(k)/HSA deductions (${amount}), but no retirement/HSA asset is listed on Schedule A/B.
Paystubs from '{employer}' show wage garnishment/support deductions (${amount}), which must be disclosed on SOFA Line 9 and Schedules E/F or J.
Paystub direct deposit references account ending in '{last4}', which is missing from Schedule A/B bank accounts (or closed-account SOFA Line 20).
Form 1040 Schedule B reports interest/dividends from '{institution}', which is missing from Schedule A/B financial accounts.
Form 1040 reports business/entity income (Schedule C/E/K-1), requiring Schedule A/B Part 4 business interest, SOFA Line 27, and Schedule I Line 8a P&L.
Schedule J reports monthly rent/lease expense (${amount}) with no owned residence, requiring an unexpired lease entry on Schedule G or month-to-month confirmation.
Claim '{creditor_name}' or asset is marked joint/co-signed with a non-filing person, requiring a Schedule H codebtor entry.
Lookback month '{month_label}' inside the mandatory 6-month CMI window has no paystub records. Upload paystubs or attest $0 gross income for that month.
Claiming homestead exemption on '{description}' requires verified property acquisition date (11 U.S.C. § 522(p) 1,215-day rule) and >= 730 days domicile.
